mapper.select: SELECT j.job_id as jobId , j.title , u.company_name as companyName , j.salary , j.close_date as closeDate , reg_date FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id WHERE j.post_check = 2 -- 구인중인 공고 AND j.close_date >= NOW() -- 마감일이 남은 공고 AND j.reg_date = (SELECT MAX(j1.reg_date) -- 기업별 가장 최근 공고 FROM job_posting j1 JOIN user_company u1 ON j1.comp_id = u1.user_id WHERE u1.company_name = u.company_name) AND j.comp_id in (SELECT p.user_id -- 상품 구매 product_id - P-C2 FROM com_product p WHERE p.product_id = 'P-C2') ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 6
